articles.title: Iran strike wounds two in Bahrain, Saudi condemns 'criminal' attacks
articles.description: Bahrain said Sunday that two people were wounded in an Iranian strike the previous day on "a civilian industrial site" in the Gulf kingdom, which has faced several attacks this week. Iran's Revolutionary Guards have repeatedly said they targeted US facilities in Bahrain, where Iranian strikes resumed on November 13 after a lull since early September. "In the wake of the criminal Iranian attacks suffered yesterday (Saturday) by the Kingdom of Bahrain... a Bahraini national with a disability was wounded," Bahrain's interior ministry said on X.
